projects.name: Securitas
projects.description: An AI voice platform for DBS checks: records conversations, transcribes to text, and validates answers against qualifying questions to speed up customer experience.

tasks.name: Build small demo for Securitas
tasks.details: Create a minimal end-to-end demo: capture microphone audio, transcribe with Whisper, ask DBS qualifying questions, evaluate answers, and show pass/fail summary in a simple web UI.

tasks.name: Solve Whisper WebGPU issues
tasks.details: Investigate and implement a robust approach for running Whisper transcription in the browser using WebGPU with fallbacks. Address performance, model size, and browser compatibility.

tasks.name: Define DBS qualifying questions and acceptance rules
tasks.details: Define the minimal set of qualifying questions and acceptance criteria for the demo (e.g., identity info, recent address, consent). Capture in a single source of truth (JSON/YAML).

tasks.name: Implement microphone capture and audio chunking
tasks.details: Implement a small web app that captures mic audio (MediaRecorder/WebAudio), chunks it into suitable segments for streaming transcription, and handles basic UX (start/stop).

tasks.name: Integrate Whisper transcription with WebGPU or fallback
tasks.details: Wire up transcription path: try Whisper WebGPU in-browser; if not available, fallback to WebAssembly/CPU or server-side API. Provide consistent interface.

tasks.name: Implement rules engine to evaluate answers
tasks.details: Create a simple rules evaluator that checks transcribed answers against the qualifying rules; produce pass/fail with reasons, and missing info prompts.

tasks.name: Simple web UI for conversation flow and results
tasks.details: Build a minimal UI: start/stop recording, live transcript view, current question, and final pass/fail summary with reasons.

tasks.name: Package demo for sharing
tasks.details: Wrap demo into a simple static app or small server with instructions and sample questions/rules so others can run it locally.

tasks.name: Evaluate Whisper model deployment strategies
tasks.details: Compare: in-browser WebGPU, WebAssembly, server-side inference (OpenAI Whisper API or local server). Document pros/cons, cost, latency, privacy.

tasks.name: Prototype Whisper in-browser with WebGPU
tasks.details: Attempt running a small Whisper model via WebGPU (e.g., whisper-tiny/medium variants or distillations). Measure load time, decode speed, and accuracy.

tasks.name: Implement fallback path for non-WebGPU environments
tasks.details: Provide WebAssembly/CPU or server-side transcription fallback (e.g., whisper.cpp via WebAssembly, or a small server service). Ensure seamless switching.

tasks.name: Performance optimization and model selection
tasks.details: Tune model/quantization settings and chunk sizes. Select the smallest model meeting acceptable accuracy/latency for the demo.

tasks.name: Upgrade to whisper-small int8 model
tasks.details: Use whisper-small int8 for better accuracy vs tiny. Ensure compatibility with Transformers.js/whisper-web pipeline and memory constraints.

tasks.name: Package whisper-small int8 as Zstandard archive
tasks.details: Bundle model files into a .zst archive on server/S3. Document structure and create build script.

tasks.name: Serve model from Node/Express or S3 with caching and Range
tasks.details: Implement Node/Express endpoint or configure S3/CloudFront to serve large model files with correct content-type, cache headers, and Range support.
